Evans was selected as an astronaut by NASA as part of Astronaut Group 5 in 1966. He made his first and only flight into space as Command Module Pilot aboard Apollo 17 in 1972, the last manned mission to the Moon. He is the last person to orbit the Moon alone and holds the record for the longest lunar orbit by a human at 148 hours. In 1975 Evans served as backup Command Module pilot for the Apollo-Soyuz Test Project mission.
